major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your main cooldown every 60 seconds: dump Fingers of Frost and your Freezing stacks first (Ice Lance at 6+ on Spellslinger, 10+ on Frostfire) so the channel refills them, and on Spellslinger send it below 3 Icicles or within 25 seconds of your potion.

major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every 60 seconds and decide the cleave angle before it comes off cooldown; it sits above Glacial Spike in every priority and turns Blizzard instant through Freezing Rain.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On Spellslinger pair it with the GCD after Frozen Orb or with Ray of Frost, on Frostfire use it on cooldown, and always burn the last one inside the final 35 seconds of the fight.

rule.description: Flurry on every Brain Freeze proc
rule.action: Spend Brain Freeze with Flurry as it comes, ahead of Frozen Orb and Glacial Spike; on Thermal Void builds send it while Thermal Void is down so the next Ice Lance shatters the extra 4 stacks.

rule.description: Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost
rule.action: React to Fingers of Frost with Ice Lance: it shatters a full 4 stacks even on a target with no Freezing, so never let a charge sit, and dump immediately at 2 charges on Spellslinger.

rule.description: Frostbolt, Ray of Frost, Ice Lance opener
rule.action: Precast Frostbolt, open with Ray of Frost, then Ice Lance before falling into the priority; on Frostfire precast Frostfire Bolt at 2 seconds on the countdown and follow it with Ray of Frost.

Keep the single-target priority through 2 targets and only bring Blizzard in at 3 or more on Frostfire (4 or more with Freezing Rain, 6 or more without) and 5 or more on Spellslinger; cast it inside Freezing Rain so it is instant, since hardcast Blizzard loses to generating Splinters.

rule.description: Potion of Recklessness paired with Frozen Orb
rule.action: On Spellslinger drink on the GCD right after Frozen Orb, stacking the 30 second stat buff with your trinkets and racial, and hold Ray of Frost so it lands inside the same 25 second window.
